categories.description: Weighted list of task categories to generate. If omitted, falls back to random sampling from TASK_CATEGORIES.

name.description: Category name. Should match an entry in TASK_CATEGORIES or be a free-form domain hint.

weight.description: Relative weight. Normalized to sum to 1.0 at runtime.

difficulty_distribution.description: Fraction of tasks per difficulty level. Missing keys default to 0. Values are normalized.

num_tasks.description: Total number of tasks to attempt generating.

model.description: LLM model identifier passed to the generation pipeline.
